title: Who Trusts AI with Their Emotions? Trust Formation and Sociodemographic Variation in LLM Use for Emotional Support
reasoning: The paper focuses on user perceptions of trust, empathy, personalization, and perceived bias in LLMs used for emotional support. While the perceived bias scale includes an item about religious and cultural background, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark LLMs on faith, religious content, moral reasoning, or ethics.
